title: nan
authors: Zhang Q.; Dai Y.; Zhang T.; Guo C.; Niu X.
key_contribution: Presents a road semantic-enhanced integrated navigation approach fusing visual semantics (lane lines, poles) with GNSS/INS for land vehicles in urban GNSS-denied environments, validated in field tests.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
